sn35.156:1.1: PAÑÑĀSAM CATUTTHAM Aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave cakkhuṃ Aniccanti passati || sāyaṃ hoti sammādiṭṭhi || sammāsampassaṃ nibbindati nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo || || Nandirāgakkhayā cittam suvimuttanti vuccati || || Aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave bhikkhu sotaṃ Aniccanti passati || ghānaṃ Aniccanti passati || jivham Aniccanti passati || kāyam Aniccanti passati || || Aniccaṃ yeva bhikkhave bhikkhu manaṃ Aniccanti passati || sāyaṃ hoti sammādiṭṭhi || sammāpassaṃ nibbindati nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo || || Nandirāgakkhayā cittam suvimuttanti vuccatīti || || Anicce
